questions.question: In story S21 (Unit-test rewrite/removal and mutation gate), is there any vacuous or placeholder production path: a no-op/stub body, a tautological assertion, a frozen stand-in constant, or an optional dependency (injected port, handler, client handle) that silently degrades to non-behavior when not injected? Cite file:line for each injection point in app/tests/unit/** (161 files referencing marmot-ts/ts-mls/MarmotContext, triaged); scratch Stryker config in the scratchpad (not committed); run report listing deleted tests and show that omitting the dependency fails loudly rather than succeeding silently.

Could `MarmotContext` be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its `dependencies_allowed` list? If not, which cross-module dependencies exist and do they flow through declared seam contracts in architecture.md (imports only via each module's index.ts, no React-context imports under app/src/lib/marmot/**, no ts-mls or @internet-privacy/marmot-ts imports)?

Does S21 comply with the architecture.md boundary rules: only `client/` constructs or disposes the MarmotClient, code inside HistoryBackend calls / inbox handlers / client listeners never awaits an account-scope client call (follow-up work via the owned setTimeout(0) FIFO), group sender identity comes only from orderingKey.account, and idb-keyval update() is not used? List each rule touched by this story's files with file:line evidence, or state why it is not touched.

Do unit, property, and (where the AC names them) library-harness or e2e tests cover the artifacts named in S21's scope (app/tests/unit/** (161 files referencing marmot-ts/ts-mls/MarmotContext, triaged); scratch Stryker config in the scratchpad (not committed); run report listing deleted tests)? Show that tests use real collaborators or test fixtures rather than mocking the helper used at the SUT call site, that idb mocks are seeded out of key order where order matters, and that at least one test fails if the production code is replaced by a no-op.

Does the delivered S21 implementation match the intent of its scope (Rewrite or delete (with decision justification recorded) source-scan and unit tests coupled to deleted internals while keeping behavioural suites; run Stryker (concurrency 1, scratch config, app/reports untouched) on the new pure modules and close or record survivors. Run report lists every deleted ) and respect its exclusions (Deleting production modules (S22))? Identify any capability owned by a later story that was built ahead, or any in-scope capability left unimplemented.

Does S21 follow project conventions (all new UI text in i18n.ts with en and de, no hardcoded user-visible strings, make-driven build/test, idb-keyval update() banned, no edits to app/ during an e2e run, and no leak of profile data to unaddressed audiences)? Cite evidence for each convention the story's files touch.

AC-TEST-5: Behavioural unit suites (handlers, persistence, polls, profile, join-request, leave eligibility, unread) MUST NOT be deleted: each pre-run unit test file with a behavioural assertion MUST either exist unchanged-in-intent (re-pointed) or be listed in the run report with the justifying decision. The run report MUST list every deleted test file with the decision (D#) that justifies it. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural (report check) ] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.

AC-TEST-6: Source-scan unit tests coupled to deleted internals MUST be rewritten or deleted with justification; no unit test MUST import a deleted module (`tsc` and vitest collection pass). Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [unit run] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.

AC-MUT-1: Stryker (concurrency 1, scratch config, `app/reports` untouched) MUST be run on the new pure modules: history backend, send helper, signer adapter, key-package lookup, leave eligibility, kind registry, invite-context handler; surviving non-equivalent mutants MUST be closed by tests or recorded in the run report. Bootstrap wiring, React context and deleted modules MUST NOT be audited. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural (run report) ] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.
